remarks: Luxury Living in the Heart of SoNo! Welcome to Sono Lofts-this top-floor corner unit offers 1,344 sq. ft. of stylish urban living with 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. Enjoy soaring 10-foot ceilings, dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows with custom treatments, and rich hardwood flooring throughout.  The open-concept living and dining area flows seamlessly into a modern kitchen featuring recently upgraded stainless steel appliances (2023-2025), including a dishwasher, built-in microwave, and range. The full-size washer and dryer were also replaced.  The spacious primary suite includes a large walk-in closet and a full en suite bath with a shower/tub combination. The second bedroom is ideal as a guest room, home office, or den. Generous closet space, central air, and natural gas heating add to the everyday comfort.  Sono Lofts is a pet-friendly, elevator building offering a fully equipped fitness center, dedicated storage, and bike storage. This unit includes two assigned parking spaces-one covered garage space (#7) and one secured outdoor space (#43).  All this in a prime SoNo location-just minutes from the Metro-North train station, Norwalk Harbor, the SONO Collection Mall, acclaimed restaurants, the Maritime Aquarium, parks, and waterfront trails.
